name: Roadside Grit Sample
description: Loose pale grit recovered beside an intact Mysterious Stone. Show it to Meliodas and bring it to Ibion at Pilgrims Respite.

name: Marked Supply Packet
description: A cargo packet bearing three cut marks, repacked among Krall supplies. Bring it to Meteina as evidence of the transfer point.

name: Timed Shipment Packet
description: A dust-stiffened packet carrying cargo marks and watch-change delivery instructions. Bring it to Une on Cantas Coast.
